match.common_evidence_basis: Fresh exception recheck of frozen rank #4. The confirmed XI still retains Santi Rodriguez, Taha Habroune, Gonzalo Tapia and multiple width/second-line options; Habroune and Tapia scored in the recent 2-0 Cincinnati win, and Santi/Tapia/Habroune were all scorers in a current-season 3-0 Colorado win. Toronto enter with a recent 2-1, 3-3, 2-0 run. Official MLS availability still lists Toronto defensive absences Zimmerman, Gomis, Franklin and Palacio. The XI therefore preserves two usable current scoring routes and Toronto matchup leakage, but does not improve the frozen all-MEDIUM predictive quality enough to convert the certificate from FRAGILE.
